nodes.label: Popover
nodes.rationale: Floating panel anchored to a trigger for content Obsidian's Menu cannot host (date inputs, search fields, number fields). Position written as CSS custom properties (--pop-top/--pop-left) read by .pm-pop, so no inline styles. When the anchor sits inside a modal the panel mounts into the modal element, not document.body, because Obsidian's modal traps focus and yanks it back to the first field whenever focus lands outside — which would make a focusable popover impossible to type in; .pm-pop is position:fixed so it still escapes the modal's overflow:hidden. On phones it renders as a bottom sheet (.pm-pop--sheet). Caller owns the lifecycle: fill contentEl, open(), close(); closes on outside pointer-down and Escape (stopPropagation keeps the host modal open).
